edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the creator and receives the entire initial supply in the constructor

randomly() seeds keccak256 with now (block.timestamp), making the outcome miner-influenced

rogerroger counter is incremented and mixed into the random seed each call
The random draw decides fauci[recipient] inside _transfer

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only used for zero-address checks and direct balance crediting inside _transfer
amount is only used for the balance sub/add arithmetic inside _transfer
sender is a transient argument whose flag decisions and balance debits belong to _transfer
spender is only used for the _allowances key and flag writes performed by _approve
newOwner is only consumed by the zero-address check and _owner assignment in _transferOwnership
account is used for the address check and balance credit of the mint operation
tempval is a throwaway copy of _totalSupply created only inside ViewSomeChange
screen is the pseudo-random value produced by the timestamp-seeded randomness operation
tok is the locally computed allowance value written by _approve
msgSender is a local snapshot of _msgSender() used for creator and owner initialisation in the constructor
addedValue is only summed into the allowance written by increaseAllowance
subtractedValue is only deducted from the allowance written by decreaseAllowance
